label: x-api-jxa-deployed
context:
X API via JXA is fully operational. Two modules:
1. ~/subconscious/x_api_jxa.py - GraphQL API calls (user profiles, tweets by ID)
2. ~/subconscious/chrome_x_bridge.py - DOM scraping (search, scan, trending)

API pattern: Build JS as array of lines, join with \n, pass via json.dumps() to JXA template. Avoids all escaping issues.
Chrome must have at least one window open. Can create via: osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to make new window'

Working: UserByScreenName (200, 2.3KB), UserTweets (200, 224KB, 20 tweets)
Broken: SearchTimeline (404)
For search: DOM scraping via chrome_x_bridge.py scan

IMPORTANT: Chrome needs a window. If no windows: error "No Chrome windows". Fix: open Chrome first.
active_tasks: X API JXA module deployed and tested: ~/subconscious/x_api_jxa.py
chrome_x_bridge.py scan: DOM-based AI tweet scanning (25 tweets/run)
SearchTimeline: still broken (404), use DOM scraping for search
